paper_title: Constraining hidden photons via atomic force microscope measurements and the Plimpton-Lawton experiment
notes: Paper derives two new laboratory hidden-photon (kinetic mixing chi vs m_gamma') bounds: (1) from AFM Casimir-force measurements (excludes m ~ 0.1-10 eV, chi > 10^-0.5 ~ 0.32) and (2) from the 1936 Plimpton-Lawton concentric-shell Coulomb-law test with sensitivity gamma = 3.3e-10. The data_points encode the stronger Plimpton-Lawton exclusion curve, computed by evaluating the paper's closed-form Eq. (26) with R*=0.61 m, R=0.76 m, gamma=3.3e-10, including the asymptotics chi ~ 1.94e-11/m_eV at low mass (break at ~0.02 neV, as stated in text) and chi^2 = 2*m_tilde*R*gamma at high mass. No numerical table given in paper; points are reconstructed from the paper's formulas, hence moderate extraction confidence. Not a DM haloscope (no DM density assumed); paper also contains projections (Figs. 6, 8) which are NOT included here.
